name: The drive aids config codec matches the firmware's nine-field layout
step: Check the drive aids config codec and ABS page
rationale:
The ABS page (Flight Tuning -> Drive Aids -> ABS) saves by writing back what it
read. The command ids, the order of the nine U8 fields and their ranges and defaults
are pinned here against the firmware handler (gripora-firmware msp.c,
MSP2_GRIPORA_DRIVE_AIDS_CONFIG 0x5F3F / MSP2_GRIPORA_SET_DRIVE_AIDS_CONFIG 0x5F40,
pg/drive_aids.h): the firmware refuses the whole write if any value is out of
range. Later aids append fields, so a longer reply must still decode its first
nine and the write must stay nine bytes; a shorter reply is refused. The harness
also checks that the page builds every field, refuses saves while armed, does not
reboot, follows the current PID profile (the settings are stored per profile),
and that its menu row and icon exist.
